Guided horse ride through rice fields to the beach

Run by Simone · Salty Cowboy
  • 1 hr or 1.5 hr
  • Up to 5 riders
  • No experience needed
  • Meet at Salty Cowboy stables, Bali

Check dates with Salty Cowboy (opens Salty Cowboy's booking site)

Before you book: Weight limit 70kg. Nothing personal, it's to protect our horses' backs.

Overview

A guided ride out along the rice fields, village roads and down to the beach. Salty Cowboy's grooms come with you the whole way, on foot.

What's included

What’s included

  • ✓Helmets and boots
  • ✓Staff guiding on foot the whole way
  • ✓Photos taken on your phone by our team

Good to know

Group size
Up to 5 riders, privately guided
Weight
Weight limit 70kg. Nothing personal, it's to protect our horses' backs.
Riding experience
None needed. If you've never ridden or are a beginner, staff lead your horse on a lead rope for the whole ride. Intermediate and advanced riders can trot and canter in moderation, with no galloping, and your guide assesses you when you reach the beach.
Meeting point
Salty Cowboy's stables. No pickup.
Get directions (opens in a new tab)
Arrive
Arrive 15 minutes before your start time
Hours
Closed Sundays and Saturday afternoons

Cancellation

Salty Cowboy hasn't published cancellation terms on its booking site. Ask on WhatsApp before you book. Bookings over 75kg are not refunded.

Meet the business

Owner-run by Simone.

Every booking goes straight back into the paddock: vet care, feed, farrier visits, and the horses themselves. Some come in underweight or scared of people. We give them time until they're ready.
